commands.review_summary:
The PR changes Worker coordinator restore, run-history, lease-detail, Azure orphan-sweep, and terminal-run pruning paths to use exact lease reads, paged scans, and a configurable 30-day run-retention setting, with docs/config/tests and a changelog edit.

Reproducibility: yes. for the PR defects from source: the new paged scan helper requires limit/startAfter, Postgres ignores those options, alarm still has full lease/workspace scans, and the default retention path deletes old terminal runs. I did not run a live deployment in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] Human review is needed because the remaining blockers combine concrete code fixes with a maintainer retention-policy and upgrade-safety decision.

target.title: fix(worker): bound coordinator lease scans
target.body:
Closes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/862

## Summary

- restore hibernated bridge sockets from their exact referenced lease records instead of materializing the complete historical lease set
- page Azure orphan-sweep lease reads and retain only active leases plus terminal ownership records matching the current provider inventory
- page run-history and lease-detail reads while retaining only the newest requested records
- prune terminal runs, events, and log chunks in resumable batches after the configurable 30-day retention period
- preserve fail-closed orphan deletion: provider tags alone remain report-only

## Root cause

Production Worker tailing reproduced the reported HTTP 1101 response and showed the Fleet Durable Object exceeding its isolate memory limit. Bridge restoration and run-history reads loaded complete historical namespaces before handling the create-recovery poll, repeatedly resetting the isolate. Azure orphan maintenance used the same unbounded history shape, while terminal run records had no retention policy.

## Verification

- `npm test --prefix worker` (798 tests)
- `npm run check --prefix worker`
- `npm run lint --prefix worker`
- `npm run format:check --prefix worker`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --parallel-tests 'npm test --prefix worker' --stream-engine-output` (clean; no accepted/actionable findings)

## Live proof

- deployed exact head `93980fbc` as Worker version `86eaa1f7-f689-435c-a62b-fb6b773579b0`; health and repeated five-record history reads succeeded without a Durable Object reset
- created Azure spot lease `cbx_d5478761a36c` on `Standard_D2s_v7`; one VM reached SSH-ready in 1m28s without recreate churn
- run `run_07bf8eac26bb` printed `issue862-exact-head-live-ok` and completed with exit code 0
- released the lease and confirmed released coordinator state
- queried the Azure resource group for the exact canary slug after release; no VM, NIC, public IP, disk, or other matching resource remained
- production error tail stayed empty throughout the exact-head canary
